en.Der redigierte Gerätebeleg steht in der: Redacted device evidence is available in the Mower variable “Redacted device evidence”.
en.Kein unterstützter Zeitplan empfangen. D: No supported schedule received. The editor requires protocol 0 and seven received daily entries.
en.Der bestätigte Mäherplan wird als native: The confirmed mower schedule is shown in the native Symcon weekly event “Mowing schedule”. Event edits are sent to Worx and confirmed by the schedule returned by the mower.

en.Befehlsstatus und bestätigter Mäherzusta: Command status and confirmed mower state are shown separately. An MQTT publish is not device confirmation.
